theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_cvl_limsup_le_of_cthickening
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (νs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ K' : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K' → ν K' < ∞) → (∀ K' : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K' → limsup (fun k => νs k K') atTop ≤ ν K') → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ v : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞, Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ k, a k ≤ c * νs k (cthickening r K) + v k) → limsup a atTop ≤ c * ν K
